title: Seagrove Serenity | KEY.co
description_expanded: Bring your family and embark on an unforgettable vacation along the beautiful Emerald Coast. Discover our world-famous beaches and be mesmerized by the breathtaking waters. With a community pool at your disposal, you'll have plenty of opportunities to cool off and make lasting memories. Escape to this wonderful vacation home and experience the best that this coastal paradise has to offer. On the first floor, you'll find a delightful bedroom suite complete with a queen bed and a shared bathroom. Ascend to the second floor, where two more bedrooms await. The master suite is a tranquil haven, featuring a balcony where you can soak in the serenity of the area while listening to the soothing sounds of the ocean waves in the evenings. Flexible sleeping for larger groups. The home sleeps 10 across four sleeping areas: a king in the master (second floor with private balcony), a queen on the first floor, two doubles in the second guest room, and a twin bunk setup in an upstairs common area. Laundry is in the same upper common area.

Features: We do not guarantee internet connectivity.
